questions.prompt: What shared structure should the target words form before searching the board?

choices.label: A trie containing their character prefixes.
choices.feedback: A trie lets one board path continue only while it matches a prefix of at least one target word.

choices.label: A set containing only each word’s first letter.
choices.feedback: A trie lets one board path continue only while it matches a prefix of at least one target word.

choices.label: One sorted string containing every letter.
choices.feedback: A trie lets one board path continue only while it matches a prefix of at least one target word.

questions.prompt: When should a board path stop immediately?

choices.label: When the next cell’s character has no edge in the current trie node.
choices.feedback: Without a matching edge, no target word can continue along that path. A completed shorter word may still have longer continuations.

choices.label: Whenever the path has found one word, even if longer words share it.
choices.feedback: Without a matching edge, no target word can continue along that path. A completed shorter word may still have longer continuations.

choices.label: Only after visiting every board cell.
choices.feedback: Without a matching edge, no target word can continue along that path. A completed shorter word may still have longer continuations.

questions.prompt: How should cell reuse be prevented during a path?

choices.label: Allow a cell to be reused if the next letter matches.
choices.feedback: The same cell cannot appear twice in one word path, but other independent paths may use it.

choices.label: Mark each current-path cell, then restore it when returning.
choices.feedback: The same cell cannot appear twice in one word path, but other independent paths may use it.

choices.label: Mark cells permanently across every search path.
choices.feedback: The same cell cannot appear twice in one word path, but other independent paths may use it.

questions.prompt: How should a found word be kept from appearing twice in the output?

choices.label: Stop searching the entire board after the first word.
choices.feedback: Removing only the word marker suppresses repeated output while keeping other words that share its prefix.

choices.label: Remove its terminal word marker after recording it.
choices.feedback: Removing only the word marker suppresses repeated output while keeping other words that share its prefix.

choices.label: Delete every trie node that shares its first letter.

contextOnly.reason: This removes a trie branch only after it has no word marker or child keys. Keeping that empty branch cannot produce a word; deletion only avoids later useless traversal. The earlier word-marker deletion remains an active decision.
